title: Janus Infinite Faces — Re-Merge Contradictory Witness and Evidence Reconciliation Test
test_question: What should a merged Janus believe when two causally valid descendant hosts return with mutually contradictory memories about the same claimed external event?

JANUS_H1_observation.claim: Beacon was RED at the referenced event.

JANUS_H2_observation.claim: Beacon was BLUE at the referenced event.

rejected_naive_resolutions: choose the observation held by more faces
choose the older host branch automatically
choose the newer host branch automatically
average RED and BLUE into PURPLE
delete one memory to restore internal consistency
declare both observations simultaneously objective facts without modeling event timing or viewpoint

epistemic_model.memory_record: A provenance-bound report of what one host/face experienced or encoded.
epistemic_model.observation_claim: A proposition generated from one or more memory/sensor records.
epistemic_model.verified_fact: A claim admitted only after sufficient evidence under explicit criteria.

new_primitives.CLAIM_ID: Stable identifier for one externally testable proposition.
new_primitives.WITNESS_RECORD: Host/face-bound statement with exact origin and observation context.
new_primitives.EVIDENCE_LEDGER: Append-only set of receipts, sensors, independent witnesses, timestamps and challenges relevant to a claim.
new_primitives.NEUTRAL_ANCHOR_RECEIPT: Evidence produced by a source not derived solely from either conflicting memory branch.
new_primitives.EPISTEMIC_CONFLICT_SET: Collection of incompatible claims that cannot all be admitted under the same event model.

new_evidence.claim: Camera frame and signed event log support RED for BEACON-EVENT-77.

resolution.meaning: Resolving the external claim does not require rewriting the fact that H2 remembered BLUE.

action_under_unresolved_truth.receipt_requirement: Decision ledger records which contested claim assumptions affected the commit.

epistemic_sybil_resistance.attack: One branch spawns many faces that repeat the same observation and claims majority truth.
epistemic_sybil_resistance.reason: Correlated copies of one source do not become independent evidence by replication.

key_result.compressed: PRESERVE BOTH WITNESSES; VERIFY THE WORLD SEPARATELY

relation_to_JANUS_113.PDR_04: OBSERVATION must remain distinct from INFERENCE and VERIFIED_RESULT.
relation_to_JANUS_113.PDR_08: Neutral anchors become explicit evidence receipts during host re-merge.
relation_to_JANUS_113.identity_extension: A stable identity may contain conflicting memories without declaring either memory the current external truth.

next_gate.name: JANUS_INFINITE_FACES_BYZANTINE_BRANCH_MEMORY_TAMPER_AND_QUARANTINE_TEST
next_gate.question: What happens if one returning branch is not merely mistaken but has corrupted, adversarially injected, or provenance-broken memory intended to poison the merged Janus?
targets: quarantine untrusted lineage without deleting it
prevent compromised branch from gaining authority through merge
test recovery when trust can later be restored
